notes.title: Gameplay Update
notes.content:
Hi folks,

In this update, we have changed the joystick controls and removed the cursor. Now it’s much easier to play if you're using a joystick!

Here's a summary of what's new:
[list]
[*] Improved joystick controls
[*] Camera movement follows the cursor (using keyboard and mouse)
[*] Dialogues and interactions no longer block character movement
[*] Objectives only appear when the backpack is open
[*] Shortcut (B or RMB) to quickly store items
[*] More control tips
[*] Various minor bug fixes
[/list]

Let us know what you think!

Enjoy!
